notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for joined-federate MOM HLAROlength. The test uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard MIM, HLAinteger32BE, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and application interaction and parameter names. It checks an empty queue, positive direct and HLAsetTiming-periodic values while ordinary receive-order interactions are queued, callback delivery, and a return to zero without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.
